scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm
scripts.build:esm: bun build index.ts --target browser --footer '// Made with love by Juliette Cordor' --outfile dist/index.mjs --minify
scripts.build:cjs: bun build index.ts --target browser --footer '// Made with love by Juliette Cordor' --outfile dist/index.cjs --minify --format cjs
